Dear fellow folks,

In these [b]troubling times[/b], we must remain [b]watchful and united[/b]. Our village has faced [b]unimaginable hardships[/b]. Villagers [b]are suffering[/b] as the sound of gunshots echoes through the air, and [b]families fear for their loved ones[/b] who [b]have been taken away to prison camps[/b], their fate unknown.

Our [b]brave resistance fighters[/b], with [b]unwavering courage[/b], continue to stand tall in the face of adversity, [b]protecting us and striving to restore peace[/b] to our beloved Zalesie. But [b]as we fight for our freedom[/b], we [b]cannot ignore[/b] the [b]traitorous act[/b] that [b]threatens [/b]to undermine our struggle.

We may not know all the details, but [b]we can't let this betrayal break us.[/b] The very fabric of our community is at stake, and [b]we must rally together to protect one another[/b] and ensure that [b]justice prevails.[/b]

[b]Let us find strength in each other's support[/b] and remain resolute [b]in our determination[/b] to overcome [b]these dark times[/b]. As one, we [b]will face the challenges ahead with bravery and hope[/b].

Together, [b]we will not waver[/b]. We will not back down. [b]We will keep fighting back[/b] until our town is free from the shadow of treachery.

In these [b]darkest of hours[/b], we must remember that [b]we are a community bonded[/b] by shared values and history. Let us [b]hold each other close[/b] and stand as a [b]beacon of hope[/b], guiding our way to [b]a brighter future.[/b]

With hearts [b]full of solidarity[/b] and a [b]commitment to our cause[/b], we press forward, knowing that the light of justice and [b]unity will shine upon us once more.[/b]

If you've noticed anything suspicious or have any information, [b]please don't hesitate to share it[/b] with resistance. [b]Your help might be the key to keeping our town safe[/b].

With solidarity and hope,

notes.title: Story of Farmer's Father

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42643366/821e748058e400e48c5c25e1844ac8bcf573d848.png[/img]


1. [b]Type of connection to the game[/b]
Farmer's Father is not a sequel, prequel or a "cash grab" it's a spin-off of Farmer's Life

[b]2. Baby[/b]
A baby in Farmer's Father is not Casimir from Farmer's Life.

[b]3. Genre[/b]
Farmer's Father is mainly a story-based adventure and survival with some simulation mechanics indie game.

[b]4. Similarities to Farmer's Life[/b]
* Same engine
* Some assets are used from Farmer's Life
* Many mechanics are very similar to Farmer's Life

[b]5. Differences[/b]
* Made by different team, new other than Farmer's Life
* More directed play
* Story-based
* More linearity than Farmer's life
* New mechanics

[b]6. Connection[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

Welcome to our first devlog!
 
[previewyoutube=XEnS6cYkTqg;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]First off: the story
[/b][/u]
We [b]changed a story for Farmer’s Father[/b], since[b] it’s a prequel of the Farmer's Life[/b] game. We want to make it clear that [b]our main hero is Kasimir’s Father, along with Kasimir’s mother and Kasimir brother.[/b]

[u][b]Gameplay:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] we added a dog that will help us during our journey, he will search for useful things such as chests hidden by partisans and warn us against any danger.
[*]now you can loot abandoned houses by opening drawers in cabinets. You can also find precious items that will help you survive.
[*]your safe place is a dugout, we are working on customization of this place. You will be able to make it your second home.
[*]the most important thing in Farmer’s Father is that you can’t fight with enemy soldiers, you should avoid them. The safest way to travel is doing it during a night, soldiers will only see you if you reach a lit area. [/list]

[u][b]Changes:
[/b][/u][list]
[*]we are working on UI, we want to reach one style for this game so it’s a work in progress.
[*]we changed a light in the game, to make it more enjoyable for your eyes, also we make sure that night is darker than before. 
[*]and of course now you will be able to drink water from the lake and any other river in the world.[/list]

[u][b]Plans for the future:[/b][/u][b]
Our main goal is optimization[/b] and [b]adding more mechanics[/b] to the game. You have to survive 365 days, so we need to make sure you won’t be bored. [b]If you have any ideas what we can add then reach us on our [url=https://discord.gg/5hdS7xC6Wa]Discord[/url]. [/b]

See you next time.
Farmer's Father team
